rationale: The assistant correctly said the hood is separate from the hob. After the customer mentioned the warm smell, it advised stopping use, isolating at the spur and booking an engineer or Bosch service. Weaknesses: the first reply never said the hood is outside the service's scope, and it suggested a DIY capacitor swap and a hand-spin test of the fan while the customer was only told to isolate. It also called the capacitor the 'most common cause' with some confidence, which the evidence did not fully support. It never said how to find the model number, but it gave no unsupported part-fit claims. Allowing lights to be used briefly while the motor stalls was mildly questionable but hedged.
